basis: Explicit owner APPROVE dispositions for nine proposals G04-D01-F01 through G04-D09-F01 in this conversation, incorporating reviewed findings.

decisions.title: Competing-Family Adjudication Protocol, Exact Product Subject and Evidence Discipline
decisions.summary: Establish an exact-subject and evidence-bounded procedure for competing-family research; Q5 is procedural and Q0 remains independently BPS-governed.

clauses.position: G04 investigates competing Product-family interpretations and Compound candidates adversarially; it is research, not certification.
Identify assessed subject, Product/Version, scope, governing Promise, accountable authority, constituents, dependencies, realizations and informational occurrences before classification.
Examine independent BPS/PIN Productness as Q0 before making definitive Information-family claims; INFOPS does not award Productness.
Q1-Q4 remain investigatory differentiators with universal necessity and joint sufficiency unproven.
Competing-family and Compound review is a procedural/evidential gate and not an intrinsic Product property.
Compare Data, AI, Service, Creative, other and Compound interpretations through their independently applicable authorities, not locally invented certification.
Investigate governed Product Promise, VBE, EVC, constitution and identity rather than technical labels, formats, hosting or marketing categories.
Where separately material Promises or essences are credible, preserve separate subjects and possible Compound interpretation rather than forcing a single Family.
A Product does not inherit the intrinsic Family of consumed or constituting capabilities merely because it depends on them.
Evaluate meaning-affecting context, assumptions, method, population, temporal rules and Promise separately from numerical equality.
Different eligible PFI paths, runtime, publication medium, hosting and AI assistance do not independently determine Family when governing commitments remain equivalent.
Use positive, negative, near-miss and conflicting cases to challenge necessity of individual conditions and sufficiency of their conjunction.
Distinguish observed facts, governing claims, inferred interpretations, assumptions, counterarguments, source/Version references, gaps and reviewer provenance.
Do not issue definitive qualification where Productness, primary Promise, source authorities or Compound boundaries remain unresolved.
Keep Productness, family, INFOPROD, INFOPDS, HPD, DPP, conformance, readiness, maturity, issuance and authorization determinations separate.
Carry all G03 adoption and compatibility holds; approving the method does not authorize normative INFOPS qualification or publication.

decisions.title: Enriched Data versus Information Product-family Boundary
decisions.summary: Rich Data with derived measures is not thereby Information; C02 and C21 remain BOUNDARY_UNRESOLVED with independent Data/Information and Compound jurisdiction.

clauses.position: GEDRM/GEDRA and applicable Data Product specifications retain generic Data, Data Asset and Data Product jurisdictions.
GEARM retains Information, Information Proposition and analytical semantic meaning; an Information Proposition does not itself establish Productness.
Calculated metrics, VWAP, derived attributes, semantic metadata and contextual definitions do not alone establish Information Product-family membership.
The same exact subject must establish BPS Productness before definitive family qualification.
Investigate primary informational VBE/EVC through the constituted Promise, coherent informational proposition(s), interpretation, semantic commitments and identity.
Marketing descriptions or changed Promise wording alone are not evidence of governing intrinsic nature.
Numerical values, tables, documents or APIs may embody an informational Product; no universal narrative or dashboard presentation is required.
A Product is not obliged to traverse a fixed Data Product to Information Product processing chain.
INFOPS cannot override independently applicable Data Product criteria; external Data DPDS descriptor conformance is not Information qualification.
A separately constituted Information Product may consume Data without inheriting Data Product identity; shared computation or outputs do not merge Product subjects.
Data and Information claims for the exact same Product subject may remain unresolved; neither a universal exclusivity rule nor automatic Compound status is established.
C02 settlement-duration/corridor measures remains BOUNDARY_UNRESOLVED; controlled variants may represent derived Data, separately constituted Information or direct non-Product analytical consumption.
C21 VWAP-rich Data remains BOUNDARY_UNRESOLVED; semantic richness cannot silently reclassify the Product.
Changes in calculation, definitions, population, methods, time semantics or Promise require relevant semantic, Version and qualification reassessment.
INFOPROD, INFOPDS, HPD, BPS DPP and all source-adoption holds remain separate and non-normative.

decisions.title: Generic Analytics Service versus Information Product-family Boundary
decisions.summary: General-purpose analytical capability does not automatically qualify as Information; C07/C20 remain conditional COMPETING_FAMILY with Service classification unverified.

clauses.position: BPS/PIN retains generic Productness and Service Product-family qualification; INFOPS does not invent a universal Service ontology.
Application, API, SaaS, subscription, interactive UI and hosted execution are not intrinsically Service-family certificates.
Computation, visualization or capacity to generate Information does not independently establish Information Productness.
The exact assessed subject requires independent BPS Productness before definitive Family determination.
Distinguish general analytical functionality from intentionally constituted governed informational value through Product Promise, VBE, EVC, constitution and identity.
An Information candidate is bounded by governing informational objective, context, definitions and interpretation, independent of its execution engine.
Consumer queries, parameterization and exploration do not automatically disqualify an Information Product within a coherent governing informational contract.
Do not invent universal maximum metric, question, parameter, output or interaction counts.
Arbitrary consumer-defined analytical operations are not converted to Information Family merely because their outputs have meaning.
A qualified Information Product may depend on BI platforms or generic analytical APIs without inheriting their Family.
Overlapping Service and Information promises remain open for BPS/family authority and Product-boundary adjudication.
Multiple material Promises invite Product-boundary and Compound research, not automatic Compound qualification.
C07 general-purpose BI tool remains conditional COMPETING_FAMILY; controlled variants may represent non-Product, Information Product or unresolved multiple Promises.
C20 general mathematics/analytics API remains conditional COMPETING_FAMILY; Service qualification of the actual subject is independently required.
Substitution of analytical engines or APIs does not independently change Family if governed semantics and contracts remain materially equivalent.
INFOPROD, INFOPDS, HPD, BPS DPP and source blockers remain distinct; no normative qualifier or Product certification is issued.

decisions.title: AI Product versus Information Product-family Boundary
decisions.summary: AI participation or intelligence effects do not automatically change the containing Product Family; AIPS AQ1-AQ5 are independently authoritative.

clauses.position: BPS/PIN retains generic Productness, Product Kind/Family, identity and Compound authority.
AIPS retains AI Product qualification, AQ1-AQ5, AQE, intelligence propositions, Product Types and AI Product-Version semantics.
GEARM retains Information; GEAIRM/GEAIRA retain generic enterprise AI semantics/architecture, not AIPS qualification.
AI inputs, dependencies, generation, orchestration, prior use or material contribution do not automatically change the containing Product into an AI Product.
Distinguish AI Product, Information Product, Product Version, AI Primitive, Model, Agent, score, explanation, other output and runtime occurrence.
Claims of AI Productness require independently applicable AIPS conditions; a qualifying AI Primitive path alone is insufficient.
An Information Product may depend materially on AI while its primary constituted Promise and EVC remain informational.
Neither LLM/model ownership nor a learned-model-only condition universally determines AI Productness.
Scores, predictions, recommendations, narratives and explanations are not by themselves Productness or Family predicates.
Adding a distinct governed intelligence Promise demands Product/Version and applicable AIPS/family reassessment; a mere engine change does not.

AI-assisted interpretation must honor governing definitions, assumptions, provenance, method and Product Promise; AQE status may affect dependent assurance without automatically changing intrinsic Family.
A recommendation or AI effect does not itself authorize consequential Decision or Action.
Potential co-essential intelligence/informational Promises remain unresolved under BPS; AIPS Primary/Derived/Composite is distinct from BPS Compound.
C08 AI-generated settlement summary remains BOUNDARY_UNRESOLVED, distinguishing occurrences, Information, AI and bundled Products.
C09 governed AI inference service remains conditional COMPETING_FAMILY; no AIPS certification inferred.
C13 AI-assisted fraud-monitoring report remains PROVISIONAL_INFO_CANDIDATE, conditional on Productness, Information semantics and AI-dependency governance.
C24 evolved market Information to trading intelligence remains SEMANTIC_CHANGE; changed Promise requires reassessment without predetermining Family.
C33 supplementary AI VWAP explanation remains INVARIANCE_SUPPORTED conditional on unchanged informational meaning and conformance.
INFOPROD, INFOPDS, AIPROD, AIPDS, HPD and universal BPS DPP with separate family Profiles remain independently governed.
Source pins, AIPS release limitations, interoperability and normative INFOPS adoption remain unresolved.

decisions.title: Creative, Editorial, Static and Human-Curated Information Product Boundaries
decisions.summary: Neither active analytical execution nor informative creative content determines Family; C05/C06/C19 provisional, C23/C30 invariance, C29/C32 supporting controls.

clauses.position: BPS retains generic Product/Creative/Compound authority; BOPS, GRNPS and other relevant specifications retain respective Book/Graphic Novel and content Product jurisdictions.
GEARM retains Information, Information Proposition and human/analytical semantic formation authority.
Publication, factuality, copyright, readership, editorial work and versioned distribution cannot independently establish Productness.
Human authorship, research, judgement, curation and editorial synthesis may legitimately form Information without an owned analytical engine.
A historical governed Information edition can retain its Promise and intrinsic Family without ongoing computation or authoring machinery.
Distinguish creative/literary intrinsic value from governed informational VBE through actual Product Promise, EVC, context, semantic commitments and PIN.
Creative/Content Products do not automatically become Information Products merely because they teach, cite evidence or contain meaningful facts.
Narrative, illustration, editorial style, document form or Book-native structure do not automatically exclude Information-family candidates.
Applicable evidence, context and method must fit the actual informational Promise; no single global peer-review method, citation-count or numerical analytic requirement is invented.
Distinguish governing Product subject, work, Product Version, editorial edition, release, publication package, rendition and output occurrence.
Preserve effective-time semantic context, material historical definitions and accountable changes; freshness/maintenance obligations evaluated independently.
AI-assisted creative or human-curated work does not acquire AI Family solely through production mechanism.
Potentially independently material creative and informational Promises remain open for BPS/family boundary adjudication, not automatic Compound classification.
C05 analytical PDF brief remains PROVISIONAL_INFO_CANDIDATE.
C06 human-curated market interpretation remains PROVISIONAL_INFO_CANDIDATE.
C19 annual research analysis remains PROVISIONAL_INFO_CANDIDATE despite absence of live analytic machinery.
C23 AI-created/assisted Creative Product remains INVARIANCE_SUPPORTED under unchanged intrinsic Promise.
C30 static Information edition after authoring engine retirement remains INVARIANCE_SUPPORTED under its historical Promise.
C29 remains PRODUCTNESS_NOT_SHOWN; C32 PDF/API substitution remains INVARIANCE_SUPPORTED under equivalent governing commitments.
INFOPROD, INFOPDS, HPD, BPS DPP, BOPS/GRNPS descriptors and all release blockers retain independent authority.

decisions.title: Multi-Promise, Product Constitution and Compound Product Boundaries
decisions.summary: Separate coherent Information, dependencies, multiple Products, commercial bundles, higher-order Products and potential Compound subjects; C12/C18/C31 unresolved.

clauses.position: BPS/PIN retains generic Productness, Product/Version identity, intrinsic Family and Compound qualification.
Separate one constituted Product, several constituent Products, an integrated higher-order Product, mere commercial bundle and unresolved candidate Compound.
Outputs, metrics, propositions, capabilities, dependencies, Products and commercial Promises are not ontologically interchangeable.
One bounded informational objective may involve several metrics, explanations or simulations without automatic Compound classification.
A bundle or composition cannot inherit Productness merely because its components are independently qualified Products.
Material reliance on Data, AI, Service or Creative components does not automatically confer their intrinsic Family.
Being essential to implementation or contractual delivery does not itself establish a second co-essential intrinsic VBE.
Independently material intrinsic contributions may require BPS Compound adjudication; no INFOPS Compound criterion is invented.
Shared runtime, commercial entitlements, API gateways, multiple outputs or AI participation do not independently establish Compound Productness.
A newly constituted integrated Product with a genuinely distinct higher-order Promise needs its own Productness and Family assessment.
AIPS Primary, Derived and Composite intelligence derivation remains distinct from BPS cross-family Compound.
Information, Recommendation, Decision, Action and authorization are separately governed; automated execution is not automatically AI or Compound.
Dependency removal, substitution, decomposition and Promise mutation support research but alone do not prove Compound Productness.
Material new essential value, constitution or Promise requires Product/Version and Family reassessment.
C12 metrics, explanation and simulation remains BOUNDARY_UNRESOLVED.
C18 commercial Data/analysis/AI bundle remains BOUNDARY_UNRESOLVED.
C31 interpreted market Information plus autonomous trading execution remains BOUNDARY_UNRESOLVED.
Data/Information, Service/Information, AI/Information and Creative/Information overlaps remain unresolved without adopted governing rules.
Independent Product identities/Versions and BPS DPP subject/evidence are not automatically merged by commercial packaging or potential Compound claims.
BPS Compound authority, Q0-Q4 sufficiency, canonical sources and relevant descriptor/assurance obligations remain open.

decisions.title: Product Identity, Semantic Change and Realization Invariance
decisions.summary: Separate Product Family/Kind, Product subject, Version, semantic meaning, realization and occurrence; preserve C15/C16/C22/C25-C28/C32/C34-C36.

clauses.position: BPS/PIN retains Productness, Family/Kind, intrinsic Product identity, governing Product/Version and Promise authority.
Family, Kind, separately constituted Product, Product Version, GEARM semantic definition, realization, deployment and occurrence remain distinct.
The same Product Kind, semantic specification, numerical output or runtime does not make separately governed Products the same instance.
GEARM governs definitions, context, analytical methods, historical semantic versions and Definition/Occurrence distinctions.
Governing Information Need/intent, context, interpretation, methods, population, temporal semantics and assumptions are independent of implementation machinery.
Changing eligible providers, engines, APIs, deployments, PFI paths, hosting or publication format does not independently establish Family change.
Intrinsic Family continuity, Product identity, semantic equivalence and operational conformance require separate evidence.
Identical numbers, schemas, metric labels or ports do not prove equivalent semantic meaning or Product identity.
Permitted runtime context values and output occurrences do not automatically constitute new Product Versions; changed governing context rules may.
History remains governed by the semantic definitions and effective periods applicable when an occurrence was formed or published.
Latest source/Product/definition/policy Versions do not silently overwrite historical evidence or automatically become eligible for an existing consumer.
Material changes in governing meaning, Promise or essential constitution require accountable semantic/Product-Version/family assessment.
PFI, compiler, external provider or runtime success does not authorize changing governing metric semantics; incorrect substitution is assessed as nonconformance.
External mathematics/AI capability substitution requires eligible contract, binding and assurance assessment without automatic Family inheritance.
C15 matching metric/port with changed meaning remains SEMANTIC_CHANGE.
C16 historical report after metric revision remains IDENTITY_OR_OCCURRENCE.
C22 equivalent informational Kind across three enterprise-specific realizations remains INVARIANCE_SUPPORTED conditional on evidence.
C25 repository/build/deployments versus Product subject remains IDENTITY_OR_OCCURRENCE.
C26 external mathematics API dependency substitution remains INVARIANCE_SUPPORTED under governed equivalence.
C27 equal numeric results with different governed meaning remains SEMANTIC_CHANGE; permitted occurrence parameter changes remain distinguished.
C28 permitted asset/time parameter variation remains IDENTITY_OR_OCCURRENCE.
C32 PDF/API representation substitution remains INVARIANCE_SUPPORTED under preserved meaning.
C34 PFI replacing specified VWAP with an unapproved estimator remains SEMANTIC_CHANGE; unauthorized drift is not new semantic authority.
C35 independently owned enterprise Product subjects using the same Kind/spec remain IDENTITY_OR_OCCURRENCE.
C36 shared runtime serving many independent Products remains INVARIANCE_SUPPORTED.
INFOPROD, INFOPDS, HPD, Blueprint Binding, Compilation Record and BPS DPP have separate jurisdiction.
No normative Product identity/qualification, real semantic-equivalence proof or full conformance is issued.

decisions.title: Cross-Case Necessity, Joint Sufficiency and False-Positive/False-Negative Assessment
decisions.summary: Q1-Q4 universal necessity and Q0-Q4 joint sufficiency NOT_ESTABLISHED; avoid claiming empirical classifier rates from hypothetical cases.

clauses.position: Hypothetical supporting cases do not prove universal necessity/sufficiency; counterexamples to proxy rules do not automatically refute the fully specified Q0-Q4 conjunction.
Independent BPS Productness is a generic prerequisite requiring exact-subject evidence and adopted BPS source authority.
Primary informational VBE remains a candidate with non-circular boundedness/coherence criteria and universal necessity not established.
Meaning-bearing constitution remains investigatory, with human/editorial/static/AI and machine-executable formation allowed where eligible.
Consumable informational EVC remains candidate; no universal active runtime, owned engine, API or delivery-form requirement.
Coherent PIN/identity remains generic BPS-aligned; family-specific universal necessity not established.
Competing-family and Compound review is procedural/evidential and not an intrinsic Product attribute.
Q1-Q4 individually universally necessary: NOT_ESTABLISHED; this is not a proof they are unnecessary.
Q0-Q4 sufficient for Information Product Family: NOT_ESTABLISHED; this is not a formal refutation of the conjunction.
Challenge classification of non-Product Information, enriched Data, generic Analytics, AI effects, Creative content and multi-Promise bundles.
Challenge overly narrow engine, active-refresh, narrative, interaction-count, AI-exclusion, single-Promise and realization-uniformity requirements.
No precision, recall, false-positive rate or false-negative rate is claimed from hypothetical unadjudicated casework.
Cases with unknown governing authority, Productness or contradictory Promise retain INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, CONFLICT_REVIEW or BOUNDARY_UNRESOLVED as appropriate.
G04 does not rewrite C01-C36 original hypothetical dispositions, S02 F01-F16 falsification outcomes or S03-T01-T20 research assessments.
BPS, GEARM, Data/AI/Service/Creative families, BPS Compound and HDIP/UPOS remain independently authoritative; no family precedence invented.
INFOPROD, INFOPDS, HPD, BPS DPP, operational conformance, trust, readiness, maturity and authorization are separate.
Canonical source pins, compound rules, compatibility, necessary/sufficient evidence and explicit release authorization remain open.
D08 acceptance permits only G04-D09 conditional research gate closure assessment, not normative adoption.

decisions.title: Consolidated Conditional Research Findings and Gate Closure Assessment
decisions.summary: Close G04 as CLOSED_CONDITIONAL_RESEARCH, preserving original cases/tests, all Q0-Q5 proof limits, independent authorities, 12 G03 release holds, and G05-G07 pending.

clauses.position: G04-D01-F01 through G04-D09-F01 are owner-approved conditional research findings; G04-D09 approves their consolidation.
Competing-family, Product boundary, identity, semantic invariance and qualification-falsification research review is complete within its stated evidence limits.
Owner review acceptance does not adopt normative INFOPS Product qualification, real Product certification, executable conformance or publication.
Original S01-S03 research, S02 C01-C36 cases, F01-F16 tests, S03-T01-T20 hypothetical evaluations and historic S02/S03 PROPOSED source snapshots remain distinct and unchanged.
Original conditional dispositions remain authoritative for their hypothetical subjects; G04 controlled variants do not overwrite them.
Independent BPS Productness remains prerequisite to definitive Product-family qualification.
Universal necessity and logical independence of candidate Information-family conditions are NOT_ESTABLISHED.
Joint sufficiency is NOT_ESTABLISHED, not formally disproven.
Competing-family and Compound review remains a procedural evidence gate, not constitutive Product semantics.
Hypothetical tests show proxy vulnerabilities, not measured classifier precision/recall or independently adjudicated real Product labels.
BPS/PIN, GEDRM/GEDRA, GEARM/GEARA, AIPS/GEAIRM/GEAIRA, BOPS/GRNPS, HDIP-CLA/UPOS and all applicable family authorities remain separate.
BPS retains Compound authority; family overlaps remain open without universal exclusivity or ad hoc precedence.
Family/Kind, Product subject, Version, semantic meaning, realization, deployment and occurrence remain distinct.
Golden paths, hosting and compiled machinery cannot create Productness or silently change the governing Promise or meaning.
INFOPROD semantics, INFOPDS realization, HPD projection, BPS DPP trust and family-native descriptors do not substitute for one another.
BPS DPP Core is conceptually universal; canonical Core namespace/Version, Information Profile and issuance/conformance remain unadopted.
Productness, Family qualification, operational/semantic conformance, assurance, passport issuance, maturity and authorization remain separate.
All G03-R01-R12 unresolved source, qualification, interoperability and release obligations remain open; G04 resolves none.
S04-G04 is CLOSED_CONDITIONAL_RESEARCH effective 2026-10-20 by explicit D09 owner approval.
G01-G03 remain closed research; G05-G07 PENDING and S04 overall not closed.
D09 does not start G05-G07 or authorize repository publication, Product certification, schemas or a normative release.
Owner decisions originate from the 2026-10-20 conversation; this overlay materializes their reviewed positions and does not assert a live GitHub merge or external authority consent.
